channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Lula: Ninguém subestima a capacidade da direita neste País e no mundo
item.description: Lula stated that no one should underestimate the right-wing in Brazil and globally, noting its growth across nearly all countries. He expressed frustration over not winning in the first round but remained confident about securing victory in the second round.

item.title: Passe livre virá de emendas e vai gerar 'briguinha com Congresso', diz Lula
item.description: President Lula stated that the free public transportation on weekends will be funded through parliamentary amendments, rejecting criticism over state burden and anticipating potential debates in Congress.

item.title: Rogério Marinho: Não nos opusemos à volta de grupo 'Exército do Lula', apenas pedimos registro
item.description: Rogério Marinho, campaign manager for Flávio Bolsonaro, denied that the group opposed the return of the 'Lula Army' channel, claiming they only requested the live stream registration. He emphasized that there was no formal blockage of André Janones' content.

item.title: Meta prejudicou muito campanha de Lula; não dá para ela assumir lado na eleição, diz Edinho
item.description: Edinho Silva criticized Meta for allegedly harming Lula's campaign, stating that the company should not take sides in the election. He expressed concerns about the role of social media in the Brazilian presidential race.

item.title: Flávio x Lula: após debate, chefes de campanha divergem 'com todo respeito'
item.description: Following an intense debate filled with mutual accusations, Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) and Lula (PT) kept up direct confrontation, while campaign managers respectfully disagreed on proposals for Brazil. The antagonistic tone persisted without major verbal escalation.

item.title: Revelação da esquerda brasileira, Ana Elisa leva Lula à era das selfies
item.description: Ana Elisa Santos, elected federal deputy for PT-MG, advises Lula on social media use for his fourth term. Born when Lula was already president, she represents a new generation in Brazilian politics.

item.title: Ouça áudio em que Daniella Marques cita nova regra no Bolsa Família
item.description: Daniella Marques, economic coordinator for Flávio Bolsonaro, announced a two-year transition rule for Bolsa Família beneficiaries seeking formal employment or entrepreneurship, with automatic return to benefits if unsuccessful. Lula's allies used the statement to criticize Flávio, suggesting the program would end in two years. The announcement contrasts with Flávio's 76-page campaign plan, which does not mention the proposal.

item.title: PT diz que Meta restringiu perfil de Lula após debate
item.description: Lula's campaign accuses Meta of restricting the 'Brasil com Lula' profile after the Band debate, hindering collaboration features and reducing reach. The PT files a new complaint with the TSE over the company's failure to comply with Minister Marco Aurélio Bellizze's ruling requiring equal treatment for Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro's campaigns. The campaign labels the restriction a 'technical failure' by Meta and demands ethical conduct from the company.

item.title: Campanha de Flávio minimiza áudio e diz que Bolsa Família seguirá forte
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign denied plans to end the Bolsa Família program, stating it will remain strong in his potential government. The statement came after controversy surrounding a proposed two-year transition period for beneficiaries, suggested by the campaign's economic coordinator, Daniella Marques. Bolsonaro released a video clarifying that beneficiaries will continue receiving aid for up to two years after securing formal employment or starting their own businesses.

item.title: Voto nulo no segundo turno faz sentido em 2026?
item.description: The Band debate underscored polarization between Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro, with strategist Roberto Reis leaning toward the PL candidate. The discussion around null votes in the 2026 second round gains momentum amid criticism of both administrations, particularly among dissatisfied sectors.

item.title: Após 19 horas, Janones retoma atividade em canal de apoio a Lula
item.description: Congressman André Janones (Rede-MG) resumed activities of the 'Lula Army' channel after 19 inactive hours caused by his hospitalization for cardiac arrhythmia with favorable clinical evolution, mobilizing supporters for Lula's SBT interview.

item.title: A contradição de Flávio na reta final da campanha, segundo ex-ministro da Fazenda
item.description: Former Finance Minister Maílson da Nóbrega criticized Flávio Bolsonaro's proposal to use R$200 billion to buy personal and corporate debts, deeming it economically unfeasible and contrary to necessary fiscal reforms.

item.title: Ato em São Paulo cobra neutralidade da Meta nas eleições
item.description: Hundreds protested at Meta's headquarters in São Paulo, demanding neutrality and transparency in content management, criticizing censorship, election influence, and judicial disobedience. Organizers submitted a manifesto digitally, while the TSE had already requested information from Meta about campaign equality, following a request from Lula's campaign.

item.title: TSE mantém propaganda de Lula que acusa Flávio de ser contra fim da escala 6×1
item.description: TSE minister Marco Aurélio Bellizze rejected Flávio Bolsonaro's request to suspend a Lula campaign ad accusing him of opposing the end of the 6×1 overtime rule. The ruling allows the ad to continue airing, reflecting Lula's campaign strategy and criticism of the PL candidate's stance. The dispute is part of the 2026 election cycle.

item.title: Lula e Flávio se acusam pelo dinheiro de Vorcaro em filmes
item.description: Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro were accused of receiving funds from Daniel Vorcaro, former owner of Banco Master, to finance different political films. The topic was discussed on Papo Antagonista, covering issues such as the 6×1 scale trap and criticisms of Keynesianism.

item.title: Tarcísio define cidade que receberá Flávio em último ato de campanha em SP
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro will hold his final campaign event in São Paulo in Guarulhos, a city chosen by Tarcísio de Freitas. The event will take place on October 21st at 11 AM in a closed venue.

item.title: Desdém com Daniella Marques expõe a irritação de Lula
item.description: Lula expressed irritation toward Daniella Marques, former Caixa president and linked to Flávio Bolsonaro, referring to her as 'his economy woman' and criticizing policies tied to Javier Milei. Duda Teixeira and Carlos Graieb analyze his stance and the defense of prisoner releases.

item.title: Eu me senti encabulado em debate com miliciano desqualificado, diz Lula
item.description: Lula stated he felt 'outraged' during his debate with Flávio Bolsonaro, labeling him a 'disqualified militia member' and demanding the opening of financial and phone records.

item.title: Manifestantes protestam em frente à sede da Meta em SP contra suposta interferência nas eleições
item.description: Protesters gathered outside Meta's headquarters in São Paulo against alleged electoral interference by the company, attempting to deliver a legal notice that was rejected. Civil society organizations accuse the platform of restricting pro-Lula content and demand transparency and reparations. The TSE had already ruled that Meta must not interfere in political-electoral content distribution under penalty of a daily fine of R$ 500,000.

item.title: Fim da 6x1: especificidade de cada categoria pode ser negociada, diz Lula
item.description: President Lula stated that ending the 6x1 work schedule allows for category-by-category negotiations without imposing uniform rules. He emphasized the measure is a popular achievement and that sector-specific details can be collectively discussed.

item.title: Lula sobre "bondades": não vou deixar de dar benefício porque tem eleição
item.description: In a televised interview on SBT, President Lula stated he will not refrain from announcing public policies due to the upcoming election, asserting that benefits such as the Bolsa Família adjustment, Desenrola 3.0, and the ban on betting platforms will remain regardless of the electoral outcome. He emphasized that all measures are within budgetary limits and dismissed criticism regarding alleged irresponsible spending ahead of the vote.

item.title: “Malandro carioca”: a frase de Lula que irritou o Rio
item.description: In a Band debate, Lula swiftly replied to Flávio Bolsonaro with the term 'malandro carioca' after being asked about 73% of votes in prisons. The phrase sparked mixed reactions in Rio de Janeiro, with local criticism toward the PT candidate. The debate also underscored positional shifts by both candidates on various issues.

item.title: Oito anos após o ‘BolsoDoria’, João Doria indica voto em Flávio contra Lula
item.description: João Doria indicated he will vote for Flávio Bolsonaro in the second round against Lula, temporarily breaking from his critical stance toward the Bolsonaros. Despite being a target of far-right militias and opposing pandemic denialism, Doria maintained ties with the Bolsonaro family. His statement was triggered by Lula's criticism of the Israeli government, not the Jewish community.

item.title: Campanha de Lula acusa Meta de favorecer Flávio
item.description: Lula's campaign filed a lawsuit at the TSE accusing Meta of favoring Flávio Bolsonaro, alleging non-compliance with a judicial decision on digital platform equity. The case highlights tensions between political parties and major tech companies in the 2026 elections.

item.title: Lula se atrapalha e escorregada vira meme no debate
item.description: In the first debate between Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva and Flávio Bolsonaro, broadcast by TV Bandeirantes during the 2026 runoff election, the PT candidate stumbled while stating that 'in a fourth term, Brazil would end', drawing criticism and going viral on social media as a comparison to Joe Biden's performance. The remarks were analyzed by experts such as Duda Teixeira and Carlos Graieb, highlighting Lula's struggles throughout the debate.

item.title: Tribunais negam interferência do TSE na mudança dos locais de votação
item.description: The presidents of the Regional Electoral Courts (TRE) issued a joint statement denying TSE interference in changing polling locations for the second round, attributing adjustments to extreme weather, infrastructure issues, and public safety concerns. The statement emphasizes the guideline of avoiding changes whenever possible, urging voters to check the Justice portals before heading to vote. Currently, 1,397 polling stations have moved, affecting 402,599 voters.

item.title: Lula diz que vai entregar amanhã ao TSE pedido de abertura de sigilo
item.description: Lula announced he will submit to the TSE a request to open phone and bank secrecy for himself and his family, challenging Flávio Bolsonaro to do the same. The move aims to counter political attacks and election misinformation targeting his family's honor. The announcement was made during a rally in Porto Alegre ahead of the second-round vote.

item.title: Mais propostas, menos agressividade: o que aliados querem que Flávio mude para o debate da Globo
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's allies suggest he reduce aggression in debates, presenting more proposals—especially in health and economy—and avoiding a confrontational tone. Criticism arose over the lack of detailed measures and vague messaging among voters and supporters. The upcoming TV Globo debate will be used to reinforce his moderate image.

item.title: Janja leva bronca da Band após se manifestar durante fala final de Flávio
item.description: First Lady Janja was warned by Band staff after expressing herself during Flávio Bolsonaro's closing remarks in the presidential debate. The debate rules prohibit audience participation during candidates' speeches.

item.title: Flávio promete acabar com entraves ambientais no Pará
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro pledged to eliminate environmental barriers and carry out the largest land regularization in Pará's history during a motorcycle rally in Marabá.

item.title: La justicia electoral de Brasil da 24 horas a Meta para demostrar que trata igual a Lula y a Bolsonaro
item.description: The Supreme Electoral Court (TSE) has given Meta 24 hours to demonstrate that its algorithms treat Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva and Flávio Bolsonaro equally. The decision was announced during the first presidential debate.

item.title: Peça-chave na campanha de Lula, Janones deve ficar mais dois dias no hospital
item.description: Federal deputy André Janones (Rede-MG), a key figure in Lula's campaign, was hospitalized in ICU after a cardiac arrhythmia during the presidential debate and is expected to be discharged within 48 hours, according to a medical report. During his hospitalization, the WhatsApp channel 'Exército do Lula', managed by him with 5.5 million subscribers, remained inactive for nearly 20 hours, resuming only to promote Lula's interview on SBT.

item.title: TSE manda Nikolas tirar posts que deturpam fala de Lula sobre 'tomar toque'
item.description: The TSE ordered federal deputy Nikolas Ferreira to remove social media posts that sexualize a statement by President Lula regarding prostate cancer prevention. The ruling was issued by Minister Estela Aranha following a misinformation complaint.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro: O que pretendo é que quem arrumar emprego fique com Bolsa Família até 2 anos
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro proposes that Bolsa Família beneficiaries continue receiving the benefit for up to two years after securing formal employment. Previously, he had mentioned the idea without setting a time limit.

item.title: Lula vai oferecer seu sigilo bancário ao TSE
item.description: President Lula will authorize the opening of his tax and banking secrecy at the TSE, as announced by campaign coordinator Camilo Santana. The measure was declared after a challenge to Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL), who did not respond to the invitation.

item.title: Campanha de Flávio Bolsonaro propõe regra de transição de 2 anos no Bolsa Família
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign proposes a two-year transition rule for Bolsa Família, allowing beneficiaries to seek their own income without losing the aid. The measure aims to encourage entrepreneurship and formal employment, with support from public banks like Caixa and Banco do Nordeste. An emergency plan for debt restructuring of families and small businesses was also announced.

item.title: Assessora econômica de Flávio fala em transição de 2 anos no Bolsa Família
item.description: Daniella Marques, economic advisor to Flávio Bolsonaro (PL), proposed a two-year transition period for Bolsa Família recipients, sparking opposition criticism over potential cuts. Flávio’s campaign clarified the proposal maintains the benefit, only extending the transition period. Lula (PT) leveraged the statement to reinforce claims that the PL aims to cut social programs.

item.title: Fãs de Alanis Guillen suspeitam que celular da atriz foi recuperado pela PM
item.description: Fans of Alanis Guillen mobilized after reports that her phone had been lost during a pro-Lula rally in Rio de Janeiro. Giovanna Grigio tried to reach the device unsuccessfully, and the actress disappeared from social media during the event.

item.title: Presidentes devem ser autorizados a ter dupla cidadania?
item.description: The debate over dual citizenship for Brazilian presidents emerges with the possibility of Flávio Bolsonaro taking office while also being an Italian citizen. The Constitution does not prohibit this, but Mexico recently approved a constitutional amendment banning other nationalities for head of state. The issue raises questions of loyalty and foreign interference.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro aciona o TSE após ser comparado a maçã podre com larvas
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro filed a lawsuit with the TSE against a PT advertisement comparing him to a rotten apple with larvae, using AI-generated images. His defense claims dehumanization, damage to honor, and misuse of free electoral time. The case involves accusations of fund transfers and ties to investigators.

item.title: Fora a espuma, quatro pontos de diferença real entre Flávio e Lula no debate
item.description: The debate between Lula and Flávio highlighted four real disagreements: health (SUS management), privatizations, international relations, and prison policy. Despite initial provocations, the content of their proposals showed clear differences between the candidates.

item.title: Papo Antagonista: O momento Joe Biden de Lula no debate da Band
item.description: In this episode of Papo Antagonista, we analyze the debate between Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro on Band, highlighting Lula's performance that evoked Joe Biden-like characteristics. It marked the first direct confrontation between the candidates after both skipped first-round debates.

item.title: Lula e a 'gravata da sorte' no debate da Band
item.description: Lula wore his lucky tie again during the Band debate, reinforcing a symbol he has used in key moments of his career, such as the UN General Assembly and the 2008 Olympics. The accessory was a gift from an Olympic committee and has become a political amulet for the PT leader.

item.title: Entidades apontam novos indícios de tratamento desigual da Meta a Lula e Flávio no TSE
item.description: Sleeping Giants Brasil and CTRL+Z submitted new evidence to the TSE, suggesting possible unequal treatment by Meta toward the campaigns of Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro. The organizations are requesting an investigation into potential bias in ad policies.

item.title: Governo antecipa pagamento de Bolsa Família reajustado para antes do 2º turno
item.description: The Lula administration advanced the 15%-adjusted Bolsa Família payment to before the presidential runoff. This social program benefit targets all recipients ahead of the contest between Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro (PL).

item.title: TSE dá 24 horas para Meta dar informações sobre igualdade de campanhas
item.description: TSE Minister Marco Aurélio Buzzi gave Meta 24 hours to prove it has adopted campaign equality measures on Facebook and Instagram. The decision aims to ensure transparency and fairness in the use of digital resources by candidates and parties. Meta must submit documents proving the practices adopted.

item.title: Deputado André Janones (Rede) é internado em SP com arritmia cardíaca
item.description: Federal deputy André Janones (Rede-MG) was hospitalized in an ICU in São Paulo with cardiac arrhythmia after attending the Bandeirantes TV presidential debate between Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) and Flávio Bolsonaro (PL).

item.title: Após o debate, Lula volta a desafiar Flávio Bolsonaro a abrir sigilos
item.description: Lula challenged Flávio Bolsonaro to open his bank and phone records, proposing a joint asset assessment before the second round. The demand was made during a debate on TV Band and reinforced in a video on the PT leader's social media. Lula also included relatives of both candidates in the proposal.

item.title: Oposição busca assinaturas para criar CPMI para investigar Luchsinger e Lulinha
item.description: Opposition lawmakers Coronel Fernanda (PL-MT) and Damares Alves (Republicanos-DF) are gathering support to establish a CPMI to investigate Fábio Luís Lula da Silva (Lulinha) and businesswoman Roberta Luchsinger over suspicions of influence peddling, corruption, and undue favors. The request seeks to deepen investigations into alleged corrupt acts involving figures close to former president Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva. The main focus lies on political and partisan investigations within the 2026 pre-election context.

item.title: Com Janones na UTI, “Exército do Lula” está há 12 horas sem atualizações
item.description: The WhatsApp channel 'Army of Lula', with over 5.4 million subscribers, went offline after lawmaker André Janones (Rede-MG) was hospitalized in the ICU for cardiac arrhythmia. The group, managed by Janones, has become the subject of legal disputes at the TSE regarding its status as an official campaign channel.
